criticized appointment abuses in which newcomers rose by attaching to court grandees while unambitious men remained at seventh rank for decades

ordered popular retention petitions to go to the ministry and provincial office, with verification and out-of-turn promotion
eased demotion and county-magistrate seniority requirements because of vacant offices
memorialized that ministry seniority rules stalled talent and that prefects and magistrates should be chosen from capable officials

claims.assessment: ministry regulations counting only years of service trapped capable men in lower ranks

claims.action: allowed newcomers to upper-middle magistrate holding vacancies to serve one more term as deputy or registrar because magistrate vacancies were scarce
temporarily allowed Hebei pacification commissions to draft appointments through the seventh rank, later abolished for duplicated vacancies
moved the court south; ordered ministry selection at Nanjing in autumn-winter and Zhongdu in spring-summer, later consolidated at Nanjing
approved Li Ying's proposal to revive Dading-era circuit assessment for nominations
forbade offices from inventing distinctions contrary to uniform transfer treatment with Jurchens
ordered removal of incompetent officials and public recommendation by fifth-rank and above
ordered discussion of cutting redundant posts and Jurchen-Han supervision of seasonal ministry selection
urged revival of Dading-era circuit assessment by censorial and review officials for nominations

claims.assessment: four excellences and seventeen superlatives had become nearly unused empty provisions since the wars

translationRepairs: In Tiande 4 (1156) candidates from the Henan and Hebei circuits were first required to report together at Zhongjing, where the Ministry of Personnel set up separate bureaus for certification and registration.

In Tiande 4 (1152) candidates from the Henan and Hebei circuits were first required to report together at Zhongjing, where the Ministry of Personnel set up separate bureaus for certification and registration.
天德四年 under Hailing is AD 1152, not 1156; Zhenyuan 2 (s0004) is 1154, so Tiande 4 must precede it.
In the tenth year the emperor told his chief ministers, "It is impossible to know the competence of every minor official below the prefect and magistrate level.
In the tenth year the emperor told his chief ministers, "It is impossible to know the competence of every minor official at the prefect and magistrate level and below.
守令以下小官 includes prefects and magistrates and those below them; 'below the prefect and magistrate level' wrongly excludes 守令.

In the third year, Households Bureau Director Aotun Ahu said, "Officials of every background should be treated like Jurchens when transferring posts, but the responsible offices ignore this, invent distinctions, and breed mutual suspicion."

In the third year, Ministry of Revenue Director Aotun Ahu said, "Officials of every background should be treated like Jurchens when transferring posts, but the responsible offices ignore this, invent distinctions, and breed mutual suspicion."
戶部郎中 is a director within the Ministry of Revenue, not the minister heading it. Translating the title is clearer than leaving Langzhong in the idiomatic text.
In the third year, an edict [stated that] supervisory officials whose honorary rank had risen to third rank while still serving as county magistrates were to receive provincial dismissal.

In the third year, an edict stated that supervisory officials whose honorary rank had risen to the third rank while they still served as county magistrates were to receive appointments from the Department of State Affairs.
省除 means appointment by the central Department of State Affairs. The worker correctly rejected dismissal but incorrectly called the appointment provincial.
In the sixth year, when officials reached third rank for dismissal, the court weighed merit and length of service for special-grace promotion.
In the sixth year, when officials reached third-rank appointment, the court weighed merit and length of service for special-grace promotion.
官至三品除 means reaching appointment at the third rank; 除 is appoint, not dismiss.
In the sixth year, it was regulated that when rank reached third rank for dismissal, the court approximately weighed merit and months of service for special-grace transfer in office.
In the sixth year, it was regulated that when officials reached third-rank appointment, the court approximately weighed merit and months of service for special-grace transfer in office.
Same 除 appointment sense as the idiomatic line; dismissal reverses the selection terminology.

He also said, "Lodging attendants were usually made military commissioners' deputies. Now Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu was specially allowed to take lodging attendants and then appointed Cangzhou vice commissioner. What merit was that? Yet the man was capable, so he received the co-signer post.

He also said, "Lodging attendants were usually made military commissioners' deputies. Yinshuke, now co-signer in the Palace Attendant Office, had first been specially admitted as a lodging attendant and was then appointed Cangzhou vice commissioner. What merit justified that? He was given the co-signer post simply because he was capable of service.
銀術可 is the full Jurchen personal name Yinshuke, not Yintu. The source traces his special admission as a lodging attendant and subsequent appointments; the quotation continues into s0085.

He also said: "Formerly lodging attendants were routinely made military commissioners' deputies; now the Palace Attendant Office co-signer Yintu can specially receive lodging attendants and then be appointed Cangzhou Vice Commissioner—what merit is this? Yet the man is fully capable of service, so he was given co-signer.

He also said: "Formerly lodging attendants were routinely made military commissioners' deputies. Yinshuke, now co-signer in the Palace Attendant Office, had first been specially admitted as a lodging attendant and was then appointed Cangzhou Vice Commissioner. What merit was this? He was given the co-signer post because he was capable of service.
The 可 belongs to the full personal name Yinshuke. The revision also removes the proposal's remaining Yintu truncation, clarifies the career sequence, and leaves the quotation open through s0085.

Moreover, those who from the guard, talisman vault, and lodging attendants complete their reviews receive sixth- and fifth-rank posts, yet those who from the start suffered hardship in specially receiving lodging attendants receive routine dismissal—this is inconsistent."

Moreover, those who from the guard, talisman vault, and lodging attendants complete their reviews receive sixth- and fifth-rank posts, yet those who from the start suffered hardship in specially receiving lodging attendants receive routine appointment—this is inconsistent."
例除 means routine appointment by precedent, not dismissal; contrast with the higher posts for those who complete reviews.

I regard this man as capable in affairs; he was once appointed censorial investigator, and as Direct Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review he never once spoke of feelings or saw to a single matter; therefore I appointed him chief to observe his governance, and so gave this post.

I regard this man as capable in affairs; he was once appointed censorial investigator, and as Direct Clerk of the Court of Judicial Review he never once pressed a personal plea or handled a single matter; therefore I appointed him chief to observe his governance, and so gave this post.
言情 means pressing a personal plea or favor, not 'speaking of feelings'; 見一事 means taking up a matter or case.
In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the chief ministers were ordered: "For all appointments and dismissals, I fear they are not entirely appropriate.
In the fourth year of Cheng'an, the chief ministers were ordered: "For all appointments, I fear they are not entirely appropriate.
除授 means appointment to office; the literal invents dismissals not present in the Chinese.

Inner and outer officials were ordered to calculate comprehensively; those who qualified for promotion but lacked fifteen months were to complete them in their current posts, then be promoted or dismissed; surplus months and days were accumulated for later.

Inner and outer officials were ordered to calculate comprehensively; those who qualified for promotion but lacked fifteen months were to complete them in their current posts, then be promoted and appointed; surplus months and days were accumulated for later.
升除 means promotion or appointment after the seniority makeup, not promoted or dismissed.
Mediocre men received instructions at term's end; the unfit were demoted or dismissed; those whose terms were not complete were not permitted changed dismissal.
Mediocre men received instructions at term's end; the unfit were demoted or dismissed; those whose terms were not complete were not permitted reassignment.
改除 means change of appointment or reassignment; 'changed dismissal' misreads 除.
In the third year of Dading, honest investigators arriving found first-grade honest and capable officials promoted one rank step and one grade; the rest received approximate draft appointment.
In the third year of Dading, first-grade honest and capable officials found by inspection were promoted one rank step and one grade; the rest received approximate draft appointment.
廉到 means found by honest inspection; the original literal wrongly narrates investigators arriving and finding promotions already effected.
Corrupt officials first grade: detained three years and demoted two grades; second grade two years; third grade one year—all demoted one grade.
Corrupt officials first grade: detained three years and demoted two grades; second grade two years and demoted one grade; third grade one year and demoted one grade.
第一等 already has 降二等; 皆降一等 applies to the next grades (次/又次), not a single demotion for all three.

Those now investigated as truly able may be selected for reward; if immediately promoted or dismissed, I fear there is no way to satisfy the people's wish to retain them—for now they may be transferred and advanced, waiting until rank completion day for promotion or dismissal."

Those now investigated as truly able may be selected for reward; if immediately promoted, I fear there is no way to satisfy the people's wish to retain them—for now they may be transferred and advanced, waiting until rank completion day for promotion.
升除 means elevate or appoint; 'promoted or dismissed' invents dismissal and reverses the emperor's postponement of promotion until term end.

Shi Zhongyuan and four others, though honest and popular with the people, had been reported as courting popular sentiment in their conduct and differed from truly upright officials; they received demoted nominations.

Shi Zhongyuan and three others, though honest and popular with the people, had also been reported as courting popular favor in their conduct and therefore differed from truly upright officials; they received demoted nominations.
石仲淵等四人 means Shi Zhongyuan and three others. The revision states that naturally without the worker's unnecessary parenthetical count.

Because Shi Zhongyuan and four others, though honest and clean and pleasing to the common people, also had conduct of courting popular sentiment in their words, they differed from fair, upright, honest, and capable men—an edict ordered demoted draft nomination.

Because Shi Zhongyuan and three others, though honest, clean, and pleasing to the common people, also had reports of courting popular favor in their conduct, they differed from fair, upright, honest, and capable men; an edict ordered them given demoted draft nominations.
等四人 counts four men total. The revision removes the awkward parenthetical and renders 行事邀順人情之語 as reports of conduct courting popular favor.

Those already serving seventh and sixth rank had one seniority grade reduced for draft appointment; through guarantee filling county magistrate, open inquiry matching, following seniority and reviews without waiting for completion for promotion or dismissal; capital-attached on review completion received promoted draft nomination; after promotion or dismissal, future re-investigation of fair, upright, honest, and capable men was not demoted.

Those already serving seventh and sixth rank had one seniority grade reduced for draft appointment; those guaranteed as county magistrates, if open inquiry matched, were promoted by seniority without waiting for term completion; capital-attached officials on review completion received promoted draft nomination; after promotion, those later re-investigated as fair, upright, honest, and capable were not demoted.

The fused literal misreads 升除 as promotion-or-dismissal and garbles the sequence; the repair restores reduced-seniority appointment, confirmed magistrates, capital promotion, and non-demotion after later verification.
In Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, the Emperor set forth ten points on official selection and ordered Palace Attendant Helu to have the provincial office draft regulations.

In Dading 29 (1189), under Emperor Zhangzong, the Emperor set forth ten points on official selection and ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the Department of State Affairs to draft regulations.
尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs; 'provincial office' invents a regional bureau.

Under Emperor Zhangzong in the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the Emperor, on ten matters of selection and appointment, ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the provincial office to draft regulations.

Under Emperor Zhangzong in the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the Emperor, on ten matters of selection and appointment, ordered Palace Attendant Helu to instruct the Department of State Affairs to draft regulations.
尚書省 should be Department of State Affairs, not provincial office.

The provincial ministers proposed reducing three-term promotions to two terms; when vacancies were numerous, officials in their second incomplete term who showed talent and hardship, or those scouted by outer-circuit Punishments Bureaus, could be promoted ahead of schedule.

The ministers of the Department of State Affairs proposed reducing three-term promotions to two terms; when vacancies were numerous, officials in their second incomplete term who showed talent and hardship, or those scouted by outer-circuit Punishments Bureaus, could be promoted ahead of schedule.

省臣 are ministers of the Shangshu Sheng, not provincial ministers. The 提刑司 change to 'Judicial Commissions' is unnecessary here and breaks consistency with neighboring Punishments Bureau wording for the same office.
The provincial office proposed elevation in rank for verified candidates.
The Department of State Affairs proposed elevation in rank for verified candidates.
尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs, not a provincial office.
The provincial office drafted: according to the imperial intent, draft registration with rank elevation.
The Department of State Affairs drafted: according to the imperial intent, draft registration with rank elevation.
尚書省 should be rendered Department of State Affairs.

An associate administrator replied: "Self-replacement does not mean immediate succession—it means registering names so that the most frequently nominated can be appointed; this follows the ancient tradition of mutual recommendation from the Zhou Offices."

An associate administrator replied: "Self-replacement does not mean immediate succession—it means registering names so that the most frequently nominated can be appointed; this is the remnant intent of officials yielding to one another under Shun and recommending the worthy in the Zhou Offices."
The idiomatic omits 舜官相讓; the repair restores the Shun yielding exemplar alongside the Zhou Offices allusion.
If the nominee performed well, the recommender gained one rank of seniority.
If the nominee performed well, the original recommending official received a one-rank reduction in required seniority.
減一資歷 means waiving one required seniority rank as a reward, not gaining seniority.
If performance was middling, the recommender was promoted or demoted as appropriate.
If performance was middling, the recommender was promoted or appointed as appropriate.
升除 means promote or appoint; rendering it as demote reverses the institutional sense.

Dading fourth year, standing rule: within one term fault of one tenth or more demotes five persons; two tenths or more demotes ten; three tenths or more demotes fifteen; if there is surplus increase, promotion follows the same; numbers of promotion and demotion not exhausted are applied as offset in the succeeding term.

Under the standing rule of Dading 4, a shortfall of one-tenth or more brought demotion by five places, two-tenths by ten places, and three-tenths by fifteen places. Surpluses brought promotion on the same scale, and unused promotion or demotion totals carried over to offset the next term's result.
降五人 means demotion by five places in standing, not the demotion of five people. The revision also makes the literal policy sequence readable.
